title: Composable Energy Policies for Reactive Motion Generation and Reinforcement Learning
authors: Julen Urain, Anqi Li, Puze Liu, Carlo D'Eramo, Jan Peters

title: Is Conditional Generative Modeling all you need for Decision-Making?
authors: Anurag Ajay, Yilun Du, Abhi Gupta, Joshua Tenenbaum, Tommi Jaakkola, Pulkit Agrawal
note: Decision Diffuser: conditions a trajectory diffusion model on returns, constraints and skills, and composes them at test time.

title: PoCo: Policy Composition from and for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
authors: Lirui Wang, Jialiang Zhao, Yilun Du, Edward H. Adelson, Russ Tedrake
note: Composes diffusion policies trained on different modalities and domains into one policy at inference time.

authors: Jiahang Cao, Qiang Zhang, Hanzhong Guo, Jiaxu Wang, Hao Cheng, Renjing Xu

title: Compose Your Policies! Improving Diffusion-based or Flow-based Robot Policies via Test-time Distribution-level Composition
authors: Jiahang Cao, Yize Huang, Hanzhong Guo, Rui Zhang, Mu Nan, Weijian Mai, Jiaxu Wang, Hao Cheng, Jingkai Sun, Gang Han, Wen Zhao, Qiang Zhang, Yijie Guo, Qihao Zheng, Chunfeng Song, Xiao Li, Ping Luo, Andrew F. Luo

authors: Haonan Chen, Jiaming Xu, Hongyu Chen, Kaiwen Hong, Binghao Huang, Chaoqi Liu, Jiayuan Mao, Yunzhu Li, Yilun Du, Katherine Driggs-Campbell

title: Flexible Multitask Learning with Factorized Diffusion Policy
authors: Chaoqi Liu, Haonan Chen, Sigmund H. Høeg, Shaoxiong Yao, Yunzhu Li, Kris Hauser, Yilun Du
note: Factorizes a multitask diffusion policy into specialized components that are composed for each task.

title: Learning to Be Different: Component Specialization for Compositional Diffusion Policies
authors: Alec Laprevotte, Haonan Chen, Xiaoshen Han, Yilun Du
note: Trains the components of a compositional diffusion policy to specialize instead of duplicating each other.

title: CoStream: Composing Simple Behaviors for Generalizable Complex Manipulation
authors: Haonan Chen, Yuxiang Ma, Stephen Tian, Xiaoshen Han, Wenlong Huang, Feiyang Wu, Yunzhu Li, Jiajun Wu, Edward H. Adelson, Yilun Du
note: Composes simple behaviors into complex manipulation that generalizes beyond the training tasks.

title: Learning Compositional Models of Robot Skills for Task and Motion Planning
authors: Zi Wang, Caelan Reed Garrett, Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Tomás Lozano-Pérez
note: Learns skill models and samplers that plug into a task and motion planner as reusable operators.

title: STAP: Sequencing Task-Agnostic Policies
authors: Christopher Agia, Toki Migimatsu, Jiajun Wu, Jeannette Bohg
note: Sequences independently trained skills by optimizing their parameters jointly for long-horizon success.

title: Generative Skill Chaining: Long-Horizon Skill Planning with Diffusion Models
authors: Utkarsh A. Mishra, Shangjie Xue, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu
note: Chains skill-level diffusion models so each skill's outcome satisfies the next skill's preconditions.

title: Compositional Diffusion-Based Continuous Constraint Solvers
authors: Zhutian Yang, Jiayuan Mao, Yilun Du, Jiajun Wu, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling
note: Solves continuous constraint satisfaction problems by composing one diffusion model per constraint type.

title: Compositional Foundation Models for Hierarchical Planning
authors: Anurag Ajay, Seungwook Han, Yilun Du, Shuang Li, Abhi Gupta, Tommi Jaakkola, Josh Tenenbaum, Leslie Kaelbling, Akash Srivastava, Pulkit Agrawal
note: Composes language, video and action foundation models into one hierarchical planner.

title: Generative Trajectory Stitching through Diffusion Composition
authors: Yunhao Luo, Utkarsh A. Mishra, Yilun Du, Danfei Xu
note: Generates long plans by composing a diffusion model over short overlapping trajectory segments.

title: Compositional Diffusion with Guided Search for Long-Horizon Planning
authors: Utkarsh A Mishra, David He, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu
note: Adds guided search to compositional diffusion so long-horizon plans stay coherent across segments.

title: Dream What I Can: Sparse Visual Planning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
authors: Chongkai Gao, Wenlong Huang, Haonan Chen, Lin Shao, Yilun Du, Jiajun Wu, Ruohan Zhang, Li Fei-Fei
note: Plans long-horizon manipulation as a sparse sequence of visual subgoals.

title: Neural Task Programming: Learning to Generalize Across Hierarchical Tasks
authors: Danfei Xu, Suraj Nair, Yuke Zhu, Julian Gao, Animesh Garg, Li Fei-Fei, Silvio Savarese

title: Integrated Task and Motion Planning
authors: Caelan Reed Garrett, Rohan Chitnis, Rachel Holladay, Beomjoon Kim, Tom Silver, Leslie Pack Kaelbling, Tomás Lozano-Pérez
venue: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems 2021
note: Survey of task and motion planning, the classical framework for composing discrete and continuous decisions.

title: PDSketch: Integrated Planning Domain Programming and Learning
authors: Jiayuan Mao, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Leslie Pack Kaelbling
note: A domain definition language where users sketch the structure and neural networks fill in the details.

title: Learning Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Bilevel Planning
authors: Tom Silver, Ashay Athalye, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling
note: Learns skills with symbolic operators and neural samplers that a bilevel planner can sequence.

title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
authors: Jacky Liang, Wenlong Huang, Fei Xia, Peng Xu, Karol Hausman, Brian Ichter, Pete Florence, Andy Zeng
note: Language models write robot programs that compose perception and control APIs.

title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
authors: Wenlong Huang, Chen Wang, Ruohan Zhang, Yunzhu Li, Jiajun Wu, Li Fei-Fei
note: Language models compose 3D affordance and constraint maps that a motion planner then optimizes.

title: Learning Adaptive Planning Representations with Natural Language Guidance
authors: Lionel Wong, Jiayuan Mao, Pratyusha Sharma, Zachary S. Siegel, Jiahai Feng, Noa Korneev, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Jacob Andreas
note: Uses language models to propose a library of composable high-level actions, then verifies them by planning.

title: Learning Modular Neural Network Policies for Multi-Task and Multi-Robot Transfer
authors: Coline Devin, Abhishek Gupta, Trevor Darrell, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine
note: Splits policies into task modules and robot modules that can be recombined for unseen pairs.

title: Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Soft Modularization
authors: Ruihan Yang, Huazhe Xu, Yi Wu, Xiaolong Wang
note: Learns a routing network that softly combines shared modules for each task.

title: Modular Lifelong Reinforcement Learning via Neural Composition
authors: Jorge A. Mendez, Harm van Seijen, Eric Eaton
note: Accumulates neural modules over a lifetime of tasks and recombines them to solve new ones.

title: CompoSuite: A Compositional Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
authors: Jorge A. Mendez, Marcel Hussing, Meghna Gummadi, Eric Eaton
note: A benchmark of robot manipulation tasks built from combinations of robots, objects, objectives and obstacles.

title: Efficient Data Collection for Robotic Manipulation via Compositional Generalization
authors: Jensen Gao, Annie Xie, Ted Xiao, Chelsea Finn, Dorsa Sadigh
note: Measures how far robot policies compose across environmental factors, and what that implies for data collection.

title: Composable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
authors: Tuomas Haarnoja, Vitchyr Pong, Aurick Zhou, Murtaza Dalal, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine
note: Composes maximum-entropy policies for different objectives into a policy that satisfies all of them, on a real robot.

title: MCP: Learning Composable Hierarchical Control with Multiplicative Compositional Policies
authors: Xue Bin Peng, Michael Chang, Grace Zhang, Pieter Abbeel, Sergey Levine
note: Learns primitives that are combined multiplicatively, so several can be active at once to produce new behaviors.

title: Plan Arithmetic: Compositional Plan Vectors for Multi-Task Control
authors: Coline Devin, Daniel Geng, Pieter Abbeel, Trevor Darrell, Sergey Levine
note: Embeds tasks so that adding task vectors yields a policy for the combined task.

title: Adversarial Skill Chaining for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Terminal State Regularization
authors: Youngwoon Lee, Joseph J. Lim, Anima Anandkumar, Yuke Zhu
note: Fine-tunes each skill so its end states fall where the next skill can start, making long chains reliable.

title: Augmenting Reinforcement Learning with Behavior Primitives for Diverse Manipulation Tasks
authors: Soroush Nasiriany, Huihan Liu, Yuke Zhu
note: MAPLE: an RL agent that chooses among a library of parameterized behavior primitives and low-level actions.

title: Bottom-Up Skill Discovery from Unsegmented Demonstrations for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
authors: Yifeng Zhu, Peter Stone, Yuke Zhu
note: BUDS: discovers reusable skills from unsegmented demonstrations and composes them for long-horizon tasks.

title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
authors: Michael Ahn, Anthony Brohan, Noah Brown, Yevgen Chebotar, et al.
note: SayCan: a language model proposes skills and learned value functions score which ones the robot can actually execute.

title: ProgPrompt: Generating Situated Robot Task Plans using Large Language Models
authors: Ishika Singh, Valts Blukis, Arsalan Mousavian, Ankit Goyal, Danfei Xu, Jonathan Tremblay, Dieter Fox, Jesse Thomason, Animesh Garg
note: Prompts a language model with program-like specifications so it composes available robot actions into executable plans.

title: Rational Inverse Reasoning: Few-Shot Imitation by Inferring Intent through Planning
authors: Ben Zandonati, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling
note: Infers the intent behind one or a few demonstrations as a compact program of goals and constraints, then plans with it in new scenes.

title: Grana: Compositional Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
authors: Zi-ang Cao, Kaiyuan Zheng, Yinzhen Xu, Haonan Duan, Jiasheng Gu, Fengyuan Hu, Nan Zhu, Kun Lei, Kevin Lin, Ruijie Zheng, Shenyuan Gao, Fangqi Zhu, Zhe Zhang, Radha Poovendran, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Guanzhi Wang, Yuke Zhu
note: Composes subtask progress with credit for completed steps into a whole-task reward signal, reusing a language-conditioned predictor across tasks.

title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
authors: Qianzhong Chen, Hau Zheng, Justin Yu, Suning Huang, Jiankai Sun, Ken Goldberg, Chuan Wen, Pieter Abbeel, Yide Shentu, Philipp Wu, Mac Schwager
note: Uses a reusable action-primitive stage estimator to route predictions through shared mixture-of-experts modules for dense reward modeling across tasks.

title: What Do You Need for Compositional Generalization in Diffusion Planning?
authors: Quentin Clark, Florian Shkurti
note: Studies what lets a diffusion planner stitch short training trajectories into new long-horizon plans, and introduces an architecture that composes skills more robustly in the low-data regime.
